correctness.rationale: Hermite convolution gives exact output density phi(1+epsilon S He4+epsilon^2 z^2 He8), epsilon=aq^2, z=t(1-t), S=1-2z. Conditional-Gaussian product and input positivity bound output factor R>=(1-6epsilon)^2. Differentiating D=E_phi RlogR yields F_tt=2D_z-(1-4z)D_zz. Exact moments of He4 and He8 together with four strict Cauchy upper bounds show D_z/(epsilon^2 S)<-7 and D_zz/epsilon^2>34 uniformly epsilon<=0.01; therefore F_tt<-14epsilon^2 S<=-7epsilon^2. Independently recomputed all displayed Gaussian integer moments, absolute-moment squared ceilings and rational margin inequalities; the infinite claim follows from analytic estimates, not this finite arithmetic check.
